prompts.prompt: Wide shot of a Stockholm theater stage bathed in cool blue wash, where seven acrobats in pale costumes balance on a towering, unstable-looking pile of crates and planks, live folk musicians visible downstage under dim warm sidelights, audience silhouettes in foreground.

Medium shot of two jugglers in dark knit sweaters mid-performance, catching an oversized dark meteorite-like stone between them on a Kulturhuset Stadsteatern stage, scattered fossil and bone props on a draped table beside them, warm theatrical spots overhead.

View inside a small classic red-and-gold circus tent, a clown in oversized shoes sneaking under the canvas flap while a small child in the front row watches wide-eyed, soft daylight filtering through the tent seams, sawdust ring in soft focus.

Close-up of a magician's weathered hands delicately holding a polished brass apparatus under a single warm spotlight, dark velvet curtain and bokeh of stage rigging behind, intimate boutique-cabinet atmosphere on a small Stockholm stage.
